C45069.observed: What was checked: exactly what the user is shown when they close a part row they have already typed into, word for word, and which of the two choices is the one the keyboard will take. What happened: with a description and a quantity filled in, closing the row brought up a confirmation headed "Discard this part?", with the body "The details you entered will be lost." and two choices: "Keep Editing" and "Discard Part". "Keep Editing" was the one already selected when the box appeared, so pressing Enter by reflex keeps the typing rather than throwing it away - the safe option is the default.
